text: My husband is American, when he came for a visit (before we were married and wasn’t sure if we wish to move to Israel or to US) he had no issues at all to come, but he was by himself, he said that he came for a visit and that’s all, he left after 2 months and then we started gathering all paperwork for the immigration. While we flew together we were always interrogated both directions but when he flew by himself no issues and no questions asked…
